chunks: To you has come an Apostle from among you. Any sorrow that befalls you weighs upon him; He is eager for your happiness, full of concern for the faithful, compassionate and kind.
ai.seo_question: What are the key attributes of the Prophet described in Surah At-Tawbah verse 128?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the phrase 'min anfusikum' (from among you) is often interpreted to highlight the Prophet's shared human nature and intimate kinship with the community, while also pointing to his unique spiritual status. This verse underscores the divine mercy embedded in his prophetic mission, serving as a model for believers to emulate his compassion and resilience in the face of adversity.
